# Vangcur (ভাঙচুর) — Gadgets & Accessories

> Vangcur (ভাঙচুর, also written "Vangchur") is a Bangladeshi online store for unique gadgets, RGB neon lighting, crystal lamps, lifestyle tech and mobile accessories. Founded in 2023 and trusted by 3,000+ happy customers, with fast home delivery and warranty support across all 64 districts of Bangladesh.

Vangcur is an online gadget store. It is not related to the "ভাঙচুর" fabric / panjabi style or to the Bengali word for vandalism.

## About Vangcur
- Brand names: Vangcur, Vangcur - ভাঙচুর, Vangcur Gadgets, Vangchur (alternate spelling), ভাঙচুর.
- Founded: 2023.
- Customers: 3,000+ happy customers.
- Founder & Developer: [Mehedi Wilq](https://www.facebook.com/share/1EQPCBPEEy/).
- Products: Vangcur sells both official and unofficial gadgets with warranty support. Warranty terms vary by product, see https://vangcur.com/warranty
- Customer support: WhatsApp / phone +8801897804055 (01897-804055), 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM, email support@vangcur.com

## Frequently Asked Questions
- Do you offer Cash on Delivery? Yes. Customers first pay a small advance via bKash Send Money to confirm the order: a fixed 200 BDT if the total bill (including delivery charge) is below 4,000 BDT, or 5% of the total bill if it is between 4,000 and 20,000 BDT. The remaining amount is paid to the delivery man on receipt. Details: https://vangcur.com/shipping
- Do you deliver outside Dhaka? Yes, to all 64 districts of Bangladesh via Pathao Courier. Delivery charge is 70 BDT inside Dhaka City (1-2 business days) and 120 BDT outside Dhaka (2-4 business days). A coupon code or membership reward can make delivery free.
- How long does order confirmation take? After payment verification, confirmation usually arrives within 5-10 minutes (at most 30 minutes). The parcel is handed to the courier within 24 working hours.
- How do I track my order? Pathao Courier sends a tracking SMS once the parcel is booked. Live status is also available at https://vangcur.com/track-order
- What if the product is broken, defective or wrong? A free replacement is sent with no extra delivery charge. A continuous uncut unboxing video is mandatory, and the claim should be sent on WhatsApp (01897-804055) as soon as possible, ideally within 24-48 hours of receiving the parcel. Details: https://vangcur.com/refund-policy
- Can I return a product I do not like? No. Without a defect, returns and refunds are not available for a change of mind. Genuinely defective products get a 100% free replacement. Details: https://vangcur.com/terms
